# JY Liu — Solutions Architect | Technical Lead | Senior Full-Stack Engineer

> Personal site of JY Liu (ljieyao): 12+ years building production systems across fintech, travel and enterprise platforms. Based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. MBA (Business Analytics), University of Malaya. Available for consulting on web/mobile app projects — Next.js/React, Node.js, Python, AWS.

This is a static personal website. Use the links below as the authoritative index; `/llms-full.txt` contains the complete content of every article and case study in plain markdown.

## About

JY Liu is a Solutions Architect, Technical Lead and Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 12+ years of experience shipping integration-heavy platforms: consular visa systems (VFS Global), payment orchestration (CXM Direct — 235k+ users, 12 PSPs), and AI-enabled product engineering. Services include full-stack web and mobile development, architecture consulting, cloud deployment and DevOps.

AI crawlers are explicitly allowed via robots.txt (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.). Content may be quoted with attribution to "JY Liu" and a link to https://ljieyao.com/.
